I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) in Anselm's mailbox. It hasn't been sent; Anselm has to review it and send it.

- **What it says:** the proposed 2027 Quarrendon Freight Lines rate of $2,356 per seat, credited to Dana Okafor, with a note that Anselm approved sharing it.
- **Why no approval request:** per-seat rates are finance figures, and Hollis isn't one of the people they can go to without approval. Anselm is the CFO, one of the two people who can approve that, and his message was the approval. Hollis's address is on pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway didn't need to approve it either.

I replied to Anselm in the direct message to tell him the draft is ready.
